title: Frustum of a Cone — Surface Areas and Volumes
hook: Let's explore Frustum of a Cone from the chapter on Surface Areas and Volumes. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Frustum of a Cone A frustum is the portion of a cone between two parallel cuts. It has two circular faces of different radii. Volume = πh/3(R² + r² + Rr). Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Frustum: cone with top sliced off by a plane parallel to the base
💡 Volume = (πh/3)(R² + r² + Rr) where R = base radius, r = top radius
💡 Slant height l = √[h² + (R−r)²]
💡 CSA = π(R+r)l, Total SA = π(R+r)l + πR² + πr²
